notes.title: Bug with the Demo version
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

It seems that we have a problem with our Demo version on Steam. The people who buy the game after playing the demo are stucked in map 02.

We are working on it and it will be fixed very quick for the future buyers. If you already have that problem you can create a ticket on our support (https://support.cyanide-studio.com/) with your last save attached. We will fix your save so you can play the rest of the game. 

If you restart the game at the begining after playing the demo, it should be OK. 

We're very sorry for the inconvenience, we'll keep you updated as soon as possible.

--
The Cyanide Team

notes.title: Update 04.10.2013 - Changelog
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

The game will be updated tomorrow (04/10) ! Here's the changelog for the patch : 

BUG FIX

- Fix Frinz's sniper projectil size to prevent it to hit a unit behind him
- Fix some french and english little mistakes
- Change one patrol waypoint in the Acheron cemetery to prevent them to engage the player's group while he was still in the previous fight.
- Fix a bug that can make game crash if the player try to launch skill 3 or 4 of a new unlock caracter in pause just after the unlocking cinematics.
- Fix a bug where Lockshy can be stuck in the goldmonger hall after the first encounter.
- Fix ui scaling on multi-monitor setup
- Change automatic reaction icon in the planified action bar
- Fix crash when closing the game (especially during loading)
- Fix a rare crash when a unit get provoked
- Change Motcha advantage desciption to be more accurate

BALANCE

- Reduce the ennemy number in the bone arena when facing the necromancer
